text:
maya: Heads-up — Q2 hosted capacity planning workshop tomorrow. Need concrete proposals for buys vs short-term rentals. Ping @hao for model numbers.
hao: I'll bring projected GPU-hours per model and burst profiles. Quick ask: include warm-pool vs instant-burst tradeoffs?
maya: yes. Ops wants warm-pool to cut cold-starts, product wants cheaper spot bursts.
ano: FYI procurement lead times: 10–12 weeks for new Ampere boards, 4–6 weeks for lease vendors.
lucas: Cost calc: buy CAPEX amortized 3yrs vs lease OPEX. I'll post a spreadsheet later.
hao: Early numbers: baseline steady-state = 65k GPU-hours/week, 95th pct = 110k. Seasonal peak (holiday) multiplier ~1.6.
maya: can we hit 95th with warm-pool + 30% burst leases?
ano: warm-pool sizing needs ~150k hours/week reservation to be effective, otherwise billing waste.
ops-bot: Deploy note: cluster-health spikes at warm-pool scale events — past incident id INC-2025-09 showed networking bottleneck at 200Gbps egress.
lucas: That's the risk. Network egress & cross-region placement cause constrained scheduling.
maya: Proposal A: Buy 40% of expected Q2 sustained capacity, lease rest for peaks. Proposal B: Small buy (20%) + larger warm-pool + aggressive eviction policies to reduce waste.
hao: Perf impact: buying more reduces tail latency by ~12ms in our sims (95th).
ano: Procurement ask: if we buy, commit now — invoices needed by next week to hit Q2 delivery.
maya: Action items: @lucas finalize cost model, @hao finalize GPU-hour sims incl. KV cache hit-rate, @ana confirm vendor lead times + fallback vendors.
lucas: I'll upload spreadsheet and annotated assumptions to ops drive by EOD.
hao: Quick check — does Dedicated resourcing change hosted forecasts? product said Dedicated growth may cannibalize hosted 5–10%.
maya: noted, include 5% churn in both steady and peak.
lucas: Quick snippet of the demand calc I'm using: `demand = base_hours * season_multiplier + burst_hours` — will attach real sheet.
ano: If we lean on leases, add 10% budget overhead for mid-quarter shortages.
hao: Also sim KV-cache hit-rate scenarios: 55% vs 75% changes GPU-hour need by ~18%.
maya: Ok — aim to finalize decision at tomorrow's workshop. If anyone sees a hard blocker (lead time, invoice timing, or vendor cap), flag now. :thumbsup:
lucas: noted. tagging finance and procurement after I upload. :+1:
ops-bot: Reminder: run `./capacity-check.sh --region=eu-west --simulate-warm-pool` before the workshop.
hao: Will run sims tonight and post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: thanks all, see you tomorrow. :wave:
